meta.title: The Floor Everything Stands On
meta.subtitle: Seen from inside a Burst job: where a tuned number comes from, where a map is allowed to live, and how a line of text gets out

views.label: Settings are routed at edit time
views.note: No runtime system reads an attribute and picks a world. The editor already wrote the asset onto a prefab.

views.label: Two ways in
views.note: Per-world tuning arrives as a baked entity. Global tuning arrives as a shared static you can also set from a command line.

views.label: Containers that live in the data
views.note: A map on a buffer travels with its entity. A stream with one bucket per worker needs no count up front.

views.label: Getting a line out
views.note: The awkward API is the point: fixed-capacity strings are the only kind Burst can build.

cards.title: Why the logging API looks like that
items: Burst cannot build a managed string, so every call takes a fixed-capacity one
The size is in the method name because capacity is part of the type
Inside a system you fetch it as a singleton · Core BovineLabs.Core/Debug/BLLogger.cs:18
Outside one there is a global with the same shape · Core BovineLabs.Core/Debug/BLGlobalLogger.cs:13
